v2ModeratePost/mapContentItem. IMPORTANT actual implementation: approve/remove set is_deleted=1; reject/restore clear it. flag/claim/release do not change deletion. claim assigns current moderator; release clears assignment. Case statuses approve=>approved,reject=>rejected,flag=>flagged,remove=>removed,restore=>restored,claim/release=>pending. Report statuses approve/remove/restore=>resolved,reject=>dismissed,flag/claim=>in_review,release=>pending. Query filters/pagination affect first reload attempt; unlike user action there is a by-id fallback. Authenticated access cookie or Bearer JWT required (cookie takes precedence); this user-facing report submission calls v2Auth only and does not require requireModerationAccess or the moderation admin allow-list. v2CreateReport: target_id must normalize to a positive finite number. Unsupported target_type/reason/priority normalize to post/other/normal. Supports ordinary and group posts/comments plus users; checks target table existence without filtering deletion/activity status. Reporting oneself as a user is 403. Inserts pending report, creates/synchronizes target case report count/priority and returns the serialized report with nullable reporter/handler. Success is HTTP 200, not 201. No duplicate-report prevention is implemented in this handler. ensureModerationSchema may perform DDL; no runtime calls were made.

v2DeleteMe -> v2RequireSelfUser, v2VerifyUserPassword, v2ClearAuthCookies. Confirmation comparison occurs after v2RequiredString trim; DELETE is case-insensitive, username exact. Successful response contains deleted:true,user_id and meta:null. Presence publish can propagate an unhandled failure after account changes.

Requires current password and either a valid six-digit TOTP or an unused recovery code. Code normalization removes whitespace/hyphens and uppercases text. Disables the secret and settings; deletes recovery codes and trusted devices. No query parameters are read.

Requires current password. Replaces pending setup secret, resets two_factor_enabled to 0 and removes recovery codes/trusted devices. Rejects an already-enabled secret. Returns the Base32 secret and generated otpauth URI. No query parameters are read.

Verifies the pending secret using a six-digit TOTP after whitespace/hyphen removal and uppercasing; recovery codes are not accepted here. Enables two-factor authentication and generates ten fresh recovery codes. Re-confirming an existing secret is not explicitly rejected by this service. No query parameters are read.

Both handlers call v2CompleteTwoFactorLogin, not challenge creation. Existing security:[] preserved. v2IssueLoginSession returns two_factor_required:false,user,tokens and sets access_token/refresh_token HttpOnly SameSite=Lax path=/ cookies (Secure is runtime-dependent). Headers and request IP/user-agent are stored with the session. Code accepts TOTP or a single-use recovery code. Item route ignores body challenge_id.

Lists invitations addressed to the authenticated user with status pending, not expired, and for active nondeleted groups, ordered by invitation creation descending. Serializer resolves inviter/invitee public users. Returns page metadata. No request body or other query keys are read.

Lists liked posts filtered through fn_can_view_post. newest/default and oldest sort by the viewer latest like time, popular by engagement descending then creation descending. q performs case-insensitive content/location/tag search (leading # stripped for tag matching). timeline=mentions/following adds the corresponding filter; other values add neither. Returns fully serialized posts and page metadata. No request body is read.

Requires an access session and an existing active public target user; there is no self-only check. Returns one record per day in ascending day order. days is parsed numerically, defaults to 14 for invalid/non-positive values, then clamps to [7,90] without explicit integer validation. engagement_score is likes_received + comments_received + retweets_received. No request body is read.

No query parameters are read. Authenticated author only; deleted/missing post => 40401, another author => 42201. Empty final non-repost content without media, invalid visibility/language, invalid body/path, unusable attachments => 40001. Relationship arrays replace existing values when present; unknown keys and unsupported creation-only reference fields are ignored. Success data is complete serialized post, not a diff. Returning the updated post can also yield 40401 if it is no longer visible, or author lookup fails. Reviewed auth/cors middleware, common body/path/coercion and transaction/envelope helpers. Error nesting checked against installed Nitro production default and H3 sendError, without starting a service.

No query/body parameters are read. Requires member-level fn_has_group_permission (active/muted owner/admin/moderator/member under the baseline SQL). Missing preference row returns enabled=true and a synthesized current timestamp. A missing/inaccessible group is not separately looked up; failed member permission returns 42201. v2EnsureGroupFeatureSchema runs before the member check and can create feature tables/column if absent; this is existing implementation behavior, not proof that a read is side-effect free. Reviewed auth/cors middleware, common body/path/coercion and transaction/envelope helpers. Error nesting checked against installed Nitro production default and H3 sendError, without starting a service.

No query parameters are read. Requires member-level fn_has_group_permission; upserts only caller/group preference. is_enabled is optional with permissive v2Boolean conversion; an empty JSON object writes false. Missing/inaccessible group returns member-permission 42201 rather than an asserted 404. Existing v2EnsureGroupFeatureSchema can create feature tables/column before permission check. Reviewed auth/cors middleware, common body/path/coercion and transaction/envelope helpers. Error nesting checked against installed Nitro production default and H3 sendError, without starting a service.

Re-exports ../role.patch. No query parameters read. Requires admin-level fn_has_group_permission, which includes owner and admin under baseline SQL. SQL excludes target role owner and does not check affected row count or target status; owner targets and nonexistent memberships still return 200 with requested user_id and role. Does not assign multiple roles and cannot grant owner. Reviewed auth/cors middleware, common body/path/coercion and transaction/envelope helpers. Error nesting checked against installed Nitro production default and H3 sendError, without starting a service.

No path/query/body inputs are read. Auth middleware requires a valid access session even though handler itself is a plain defineEventHandler. No prediction request or upstream connection test occurs. Returns current configuration even when enabled=false. baseUrlConfigured can be true due to a derived localhost default; it is not a readiness assertion. Middleware authentication still uses Oracle to validate/update access session. Reviewed auth/cors middleware, common body/path/coercion and transaction/envelope helpers. Error nesting checked against installed Nitro production default and H3 sendError, without starting a service.
